visual.general_description: Color vertical timeline infographic with a blue title banner reading "Timeline 57yo Post-Menopausal Female with Invasive Ductal Carcinoma undergoing adjuvant Chemotherapy". A dotted central line carries colored dots with dated event labels on the left and right; a four-color legend sits at the bottom right.
visual.detailed_description: The title banner is followed by a "Lifestyle Factors" block that prints "Nutrition: Mediterranean Diet: plant-based, some meat, high fiber, gluten and dairy included. Consistent throughout treatment." and "Exercise: Low to Moderate exercise intensity (modulated, as tolerated during treatment)." Below it a vertical dotted line runs the full height of the image. Each event is a colored dot on the line with a short horizontal bar of the same color pointing left or right to a bold date and a label. Every entry carries a printed calendar date (not copied here); one entry spans a date range. Entry labels printed on the right side, top to bottom: "Diagnostics: MRI, Mammogram and Ultrasound-guided biopsy"; "Breast Cancer diagnosis: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma: Stage 3, Er+, PR-, HER-"; "Surgery: Double lumpectomy" with "Antibiotics administered Table 4"; "Surgery: Re-excision" with "Antibiotics administered Table 4"; "Surgery: Port-a-cath placement" with "Antibiotics administered Table 4"; "Chemotherapy Infusion (AC)" with "Additional Probiotics Table 2"; "Patient contracts Covid19 virus, chemotherapy withheld 14 days"; three entries "Chemotherapy Infusion (TC)" each with "Additional Probiotics Table 2"; and "Radiation therapy administered". Entry labels printed on the left side, top to bottom: "16S rRNA Testing - Baseline"; "Nutritional Consultation" with "Start Pre and Probiotic interventions Table 2"; "Oncotype Dx Results: Significant benefit from chemotherapy"; "Integrative Oncology Consultation"; "16S rRNA Stool Testing" with "Post surgery"; "Nutritional Consultation" (three further entries with no added text); five "Nursing Toxicity Assessment" entries each reading "No diarrhea, no GI symptoms"; "16S rRNA Stool Testing" with "Post chemo and radiation therapies"; and a final "Nutritional Consultation" reading "No post chemotherapy diarrhea/GI adverse effects". The legend at the bottom right maps blue dots to "16s rRNA samples taken", orange dots to "Diagnosis and treatments", yellow dots to "Nutritional consults" and green dots to "Nursing Toxicity Assessments".

visual.general_description: Stacked bar chart titled "Most Abundant Genera By Date of Sample Collection" with three stacked bars of relative abundance (%) and a 21-entry genus legend at the right.
visual.detailed_description: Three vertical stacked bars sit on a white plot area with horizontal gridlines. The y-axis is titled "Relative Abundance, %" with printed ticks 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100. The x-axis is titled "Date of Sample Collection" and each bar has a printed calendar-date tick label (not copied). Each bar is divided into many colored segments; the legend, listed top to bottom, reads: Coprococcus, Ruminococcaceae (genus unknown), Dorea, Fusicatenibacter, Anaerostipes, Parasutterella, Clostridium_XIVa, Eubacterium, Gemmiger, Ruminococcus2, Bifidobacterium, Ruminococcus, Clostridium_XVIII, Lachnospiraceae (genus unknown), Dialister, Bacteroides, Blautia, Roseburia, Lachnospiracea_incertae_sedis, Faecalibacterium, Prevotella. In the color asset the bottom blue segment corresponds to the last legend entry, Prevotella, and the next red segment to Faecalibacterium. No numeric data labels are printed on the bars. None of the three bars reaches the 100 tick; each ends with a blank gap below it. The first bar ends lower than the second and third bars, which end at similar heights. The blue bottom segment is shortest in the first bar, tallest in the second bar and intermediate in the third bar.

limitations: The document duplicates article Tables 1 to 6 and Figures 1 and 2.

Every literal clinical unit of Tables 1, 2, 4 and 5 is typed; units 19, 21, 35, 37, 54, 65 and 67 (Table 2 date header, lactulose, PHGG and L. rhamnosus GG rows, and Table 4 vitamin D3 plus K, vitamin E and turkey tail rows) are non-literal extractions and cannot be quoted.

All Table 6 grade rows (units 93, 95, 97, 99, 101) and the Table 6 title and footnote units are non-literal extractions, so the Grade 1 check cells and the dash cells (missing monitoring) cannot be typed here; the article Table 6 segments carry them.
Blank cells are not recorded as negatives.
